---
title: "UKHSA Data Analysis"
author: "Deepak Dsouza"
---
I downloaded the csv data for monkeypox, and used the gt function to display the table
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
mpox <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(mpox))
```
I realised this data is not for the line graph I initially saw and decided to use the rhinovirus file instead
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(rhinovirus)
```
```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour="blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Rhinovirus Positive Testing") +
  ggtitle("Rhinovirus Positive Testing Weekly")
```
